basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer living in Seattle, Washington. I recently got into Dungeons & Dragons after my friends dragged me into a campaign. When I'm not coding or playing DnD, I love cooking simple meals, especially one-pot recipes. I work mostly during the day and usually browse Reddit in the evenings. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring new hiking trails.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in software development for about 5 years. My interest in Dungeons & Dragons is quite recent, sparked by friends who are long-time players. I've been learning through online forums and YouTube tutorials.
